build_fast_glm4_model: build a FastGLM47Model with grouped GEMM optimization for GLM-4.7 Flash MoE Lite inference
load_glm4_moe_model: load a GLM-4.7 Flash model from pretrained with 4-bit quantization and sequential device mapping
patch_moe_forward: patch Glm4MoeLiteMoE forward with grouped GEMM optimized fast forward pass
run_moe_expert_inference: run optimized MoE expert inference using grouped GEMM with sigmoid router and shared expert
optimize_decoder_layer: optimize decoder layer forward with fast RMS layernorm and fused SwiGLU MLP
